user_roles_revoked_together.name: user_roles_revoked_together
user_roles_revoked_together.value:
("user_roles"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "user_roles"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "user_roles"."revoke_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("user_roles"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "user_roles"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("user_roles"."revoke_reason") <> '')

document_lines_discount_reason.name: document_lines_discount_reason
document_lines_discount_reason.value: "document_lines"."discount" = 0 OR ("document_lines"."discount_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("document_lines"."discount_reason") <> '')

documents_number_by_status.name: documents_number_by_status
documents_number_by_status.value:
("documents"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "documents"."number" IS NULL)
        OR ("documents"."status" IN ('SUBMITTED', 'REJECTED', 'APPROVED', 'POSTED') AND "documents"."number" IS NOT NULL)
        OR "documents"."status" = 'ANNULLED'

contract_vehicles_removed_together.name: contract_vehicles_removed_together
contract_vehicles_removed_together.value:
("contract_vehicles"."removed_on" IS NULL AND "contract_vehicles"."removed_by" IS NULL AND "contract_vehicles"."remove_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("contract_vehicles"."removed_on" IS NOT NULL AND "contract_vehicles"."removed_by" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("contract_vehicles"."remove_reason") <> '')

contracts_status_reason.name: contracts_status_reason
contracts_status_reason.value: "contracts"."status" = 'ACTIVE' OR ("contracts"."status_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("contracts"."status_reason") <> '')

contracts_non_negative.name: contracts_non_negative
contracts_non_negative.value:
"contracts"."deferred_payment_days" >= 0
        AND coalesce("contracts"."advance_threshold_ex_vat", 0) >= 0
        AND coalesce("contracts"."advance_percent", 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        AND coalesce("contracts"."penalty_rate_daily", 0) >= 0
        AND coalesce("contracts"."penalty_cap_percent", 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 100

job_orders_contract_decision.name: job_orders_contract_decision
job_orders_contract_decision.value:
("job_orders"."contract_decision" IS NULL OR "job_orders"."contract_decision" IN ('SEPARATE_PAID', 'HOLD_FOR_MANAGEMENT'))
        AND (("job_orders"."contract_decision" IS NOT NULL) = ("job_orders"."contract_check" IN ('NOT_ON_CONTRACT', 'CONTRACT_EXPIRED')))
